title: Slice-and-Run daily capture
content:
2026-03-13 morning dump - quick capture for today

Top context: final PRD pass before canary (voice-search-v2). Need to confirm 2 things: (1) latency SLO for 512-token seq on dedicated vs hosted; (2) rollout fallback policy when quantized variant fails.

Top 3 priorities
- Lock PRD language + acceptance criteria (see inline comments) — target: EOD PST
- Confirm infra checklist with SRE (cancan) and toggle plan for feature flag
- Stakeholder sync: legal+security signoff by Thu (03/16) or push to next sprint

PRD edits (notes-to-self)
- Section: "Failure modes" needs clearer examples (add table: model timeout -> fallback to 7B-fast -> return cached answer).
- Acceptance: add explicit perf test: median p95 token latency <= 160ms on dedicated-4 for 512 tokens. (Liam to verify perf harness)
- Data handling: clarify that debug logs are not persisted beyond 7 days unless opt-in (privacy/legal ask).
- Add rollout metric: % of requests hitting fallback path per minute + alert when > 0.5% for 10m.
- Remove ambiguous phrasing in "compatibility" paragraph — replace with: "Model variants are API-compatible; client code must handle consistent response headers."

Unresolved decisions (open)
- Do we support structured tool-calling in initial canary? Pros: better UX; Cons: increases explosion of failure cases. (ask Ruth)
- Canary size: 1% or 5%? Ops prefers 1%. Product would like 5% to get more signal. (SLO/rollback clarity needed)

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick list)
- @Diego: Confirm quantized 4-bit artifact is uploadable to dedicated pools and list of supported GPUs. (due 03/14)
- @Ruth: Legal review of telemetry redaction language (link in confluence). (due 03/15)
- @Liam: Run perf harness (PROJ-2345) with dedicated-4, attach results to PRD. (due 03/13 EOD)
- @SRE (can-can): Can we smoke test autoscaler simple workload for canary window? Tell me earliest slot.

Launch checklist (scratch)
- Build: create canary branch + tag (done: branch created, need tag)
- Infra: create dedicated pool allocation & reservation tickets (ticket # infra-911)
- Feature flag: create flag + default off. Add experiment config in Launch Console.
- Monitoring: dashboards (latency, fallback %, error rate) — add alert thresholds.
- Logging: ensure debug logs honor redaction. Add sample log lines to PRD.
- Rollback: hotfix plan (repoint traffic, disable model, route to baseline model) — write steps in runbook.
- Post-launch: collect 48h sample prompts for quality evals.

Quick meeting notes (standup + 1:1)
- 09:15 standup: Liam — perf harness running, Diego — quantize upload in progress, SRE — autoscaler smoke next window at 2pm PST.
- 10:00 1:1 w/ Ruth: legal redaction fine but wants stronger phrasing around PII; flagged for product wording update.

Immediate blockers
- Need SRE slot to run canary autoscale smoke (blocks readiness).
- Missing perf number from Liam (blocks acceptance).

Quick TODOs (5-15m)
- Add one-sentence clarification in PRD "debug logs retention" (done, push commit)
- Draft Slack note for #launch-hq summarizing plan for canary (pull request link + ask for monitoring eyes)
- Open infra-911 ticket and tag SRE

Notes to self (clipboard)
- Keep PRD edits as minimal delta — avoid scope creep. If a new feature is requested, add to backlog not canary.
- Use canary as signal for infra assumptions not for feature parity.
- Remember to link the GH PR number in the confluence page after merge.

Backburner / not for canary
- Structured tool-calling support (big effort)
- Multi-region warm pools
- Embeddings-index prefetching

Random capture:
- Idea: small "chaos" test during canary where we intentionally inject a slow backend for 2% of requests to validate fallback path. Worth discussing with SRE.

End of note.

-- Aisha
